shape_coverage: Full declared supported nonrespondent scope: 128 supported questions/response slots, 3 coordinate slots, 128 routing rules
Five fixed nonrespondent rows; every supported response slot and every declared coordinate slot has a cell in every row.
Per-slot state pattern: first substantive code, last substantive code, DK where declared, refusal/inapplicable/special where declared, and a system-missing final row.
The P3 fixture-scoped exact row-key path is exercised with one explicitly nonrespondent key witness per row.
oracle_basis: Expected state/canonical values are computed from these explicit fixture cells and the source config's serialized value rules before the native call.
limits: Repository-generated nonrespondent input; not original respondent data.
Fixture authority is NONRESPONDENT_FIXTURE_ONLY and cannot be promoted.
Full supported fixture validation does not establish original-source scientific results or execution permission.
